description: Every version here is an exact pin (Enforcer banDynamicVersions). This is the named path for moving a pin: a PR per update, digest-pinned actions and images, no automerge. Renovate itself is AGPL-3.0; as a hosted app it never enters the dependency graph the licence gate reads.

packageRules.description: jqwik ceiling: 1.9.3 or lower is a safety control (llm-default-traps). Never propose a bump.
Major moves of the pinned platforms are a deliberate commit with a recorded source and date, not a bot PR.
